citation: Prevention of Corruption Act 1960 (Singapore), 2020 Revised Edition

source.version_stated: Current version as at 01 Oct 2026; PDF created date 01 Oct 2026
source.edition: 2020 Revised Edition, which incorporates all amendments up to and including 1 December 2021 and came into operation on 31 December 2021; the text carries no marginal amendment after that date
source.note: Singapore Statutes Online PDF, an unofficial consolidation (SSO Terms of Use cl.8). One vintage: the law as at 01 Oct 2026. The PDF was supplied to the encoder from the user's folder 'SG Acts'; how it was fetched (by hand or by a script) is not known. Text and PDF deposited in source/; see source/PROVENANCE.md.

scope_note: The encoding covers every operative provision of Parts 1, 3, 4, 5 and 6 and ss 3 and 4 of Part 2: the offences (ss 5 to 12, 18(2), 21(2), 26, 28, 32(2)), the presumption and the deeming (ss 8, 9), the penalty rules (ss 7, 13), abetment, attempt and conspiracy (ss 29 to 31), the powers of arrest, investigation and search (ss 15 to 22), the evidence rules (ss 23 to 25, 36), and the procedural sections (ss 32 to 35, 37). ss 4A to 4F (the CPIB officers' superannuation scheme) are not encoded; see encodings/NOTES.md.

related_subjects.criminal-procedure-code-2010: sg/criminal-procedure-code-2010: the interface module written-law-interface.l4 is carried identically in this row, the Code's row and the Misuse of Drugs Act row; the Code reads the Act's statement about its own offences (s 32(1) arrestable, s 34 District Court) in cpc-other-laws.l4. The Act is item 16A of the Code's Second Schedule.
related_subjects.penal-code-1871: sg/penal-code-1871: ss 161 to 165 and 213 to 215 are named by ss 17, 20 to 22, 24, 28 and 35; 'abets' and 'criminal conspiracy' (ss 29 to 31) and 'public servant' (s 4(1)) are the Code's; the Code's s 4B Schedule item 15 excludes this Act's offences
related_subjects.evidence-act-1893: sg/evidence-act-1893: s 25 (accomplice) answers the caution of the Evidence Act s 116 illustration (b); s 36 is the counterpart of ss 126 and 127; 'proved' in s 8 is the Evidence Act s 3's word
related_subjects.misuse-of-drugs-act-1973: sg/misuse-of-drugs-act-1973: the other Act that creates its own offences and procedure and makes a statement to the Code
